details: The title is pretty self explanatory, a filter for groups, avatars, profiles, and worlds if they have an AI generated image. How this feature would work is the player can choose to hide (or inform about) content that contains AI-generated media, if the content scanned for AI-generated media, a bot icon would appear in the corner of the thumbnail or instance. This ensures if a player would not like to see AI-generated media, they can use this feature.
title: Filters for AI-generated content
